name: Giraffe
body:
The giraffe has a very long neck, legs and black tongue. Its fur has a light yellowish colour with dark patches and its head bears small horn-like stumps.

Giraffe, Male

CR 4

XP 1200
N Large animal
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 10, flat-footed 11 (+1 Dex, -1 size, +2 natural)
hp 36 (3d8+23)
Fort +7, Ref +5, Will +1;

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee slam +5 (1d8+12)
Space 10 ft. Reach 10 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 13, Con 20, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 7;
Base Atk 0; CMB 5; CMD 16
Feats Lightning Reflexes, Run
Skills Perception +5

Giraffe, Female
	CR 3

XP 800
N Medium animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +0 size, +1 natural)
hp 30 (3d8+17)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +1;

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee slam +3 (1d6+4)
Space 5 ft. Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 15, Con 16, Int 2, Wis 13, Cha 7;
Base Atk 1; CMB 0; CMD 15
Feats Lightning Reflexes, Run
Skills Perception +5

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate or warm plains
Organization solitary, pair, or nursery herd (3-10 adult females and an equal number of calves)
Treasure none
